name: Hlido Agent Trust
description: Gate LLM/agent requests on Hlido's independent, evidence-backed trust scores for shipped AI agent products. No API key required — Hlido's review data is public. Blocks (or flags) requests routed to an agent that scores below your threshold or has no independent review.

description.text: Verify the target agent/model against its independent Hlido trust score before the request runs. Uses the public Hlido review corpus (no auth).
The Hlido slug of the agent/tool to verify (e.g. 'aider'). Look it up at https://hlido.eu/check/. If omitted, the request provider name is used as a best-effort match.
Fail the guardrail when the agent's Hlido score (0–100) is below this. Default 70 (STEADY tier).
When true, fail the guardrail if the agent has no independent Hlido review. When false (default), unreviewed agents pass with a note.
